prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.396 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS4 mean temperature 30.8 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.99 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.46 l/min (within 2% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 395 W·min/l (3% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.1 % (4% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.7 bar (2% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
